task.title: Determining if the electronic file requires updating

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there are earlier BPCs established with the old SIN:

ul.li: If no, go to Electronic file update not required . Electronic file update not required
If yes, go to Electronic file update required . Electronic file update required

step.cmd: In NWS, using the old SIN determine if there is a WI related to the SIN change that was not deleted.

ul.li: If no, no further action is required.
If yes, complete the WI.

step.cmd: In FTS, using the old SIN select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the registration number assigned to the initial application with the old SIN.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts .
Infraction: Select B - Non-fraud - Availability, capability .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim with the request for a SIN change.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 34 - Social insurance number change .
Remarks line 1: Type “SIN change to new SIN [new SIN].”

Remarks line 2 to 4: Enter the appropriate options:
The list of all BPCs with the old SIN.
If a D15 is imposed from the BPC under the 900-series SIN for the same BPC that will be established with the permanent SIN and the D15 is not required for the permanent SIN, type “Do not transfer BPC [XXXX] from old SIN. BPC [XXXX] is on new SIN.”
If necessary, type “Calculation result under new SIN has been reviewed.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Transfer the registration number to IPOC, selecting the appropriate registration number from the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the registration number assigned to the initial application with the old SIN.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, using the old SIN, determine if there is a WI related to the SIN change that was not deleted:

ul.li: If no, no further action is required.
If yes, complete the WI.
